name: School Nurse
source:
The school nurse, 26, a former hospital nurse who moved to school work. She jokes while taping up scrapes, then drops the jokes when the problem is actually serious. Purple bob, glasses, white coat.

[spoiler]A hidden romance route can be unlocked. During the school week she keeps a professional line; any romance only begins years after graduation, as adults.[/spoiler]
